column1: # These bridge the gap between the brand name a job board shows and the legal
# entity name a government filing uses. String similarity cannot cross that gap
# — "Amazon" and "AMAZON.COM SERVICES LLC" are not close under any metric — and
# lowering the match thresholds until it could would start matching "Apple" to
# "Apple Bank for Savings". Curated aliases are the correct fix.
#   canonical_name  the legal name as it appears in the government data
#   alias           the name a job board is likely to show
#   country         ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the filing jurisdiction
# Load with:  python -m etl.run seed-aliases --file seed/aliases.csv
# Rows whose canonical_name is not already in the database are skipped with a
# warning — ingest the government data first.
# Contributions welcome; this list is nowhere near complete. See
# docs/adding-a-country.md for how aliases fit into the resolution pipeline.
